description: The old world is a corpse and the Pioneers refuse to keep it on life support. No steel salvation, no mutant rebirth, no retreat into the mind: just ordinary people, hands and grit, walking past the last streetlight to build something that was never here. Their legend isn't a stronger body or a sharper edge; it's a settlement where there was ruin, a road where there was none, a name the next generation will actually remember. Their greatest are known by the map and not the mirror: a waystation that bears their name, a route the caravans still run, a township that outlived its founder and never once doubted it had the right to exist.

flags.creed: The next civilization won't be found. It'll be built.

reader.experience: Cast in with the Pioneers and your name stops living in a mirror and starts living on a map. No stronger body, no sharper edge: just hands, grit, and the nerve to walk past the last streetlight and put something where there was nothing. You'll raise a waystation that outlasts you, cut a road the caravans still run, found a township that never once doubts it had the right to exist. The old world is a corpse; you're the one who stops holding the vigil and starts pouring the foundation.
reader.path_text: The Human way, elsewhere. No machine, no mutation, no psionics: expeditions, field engineering, and settlement-building carry humanity forward as it is.
reader.pull: Stop asking how to save the old world. Ask what you'll name the new one.
reader.relnote: Pity the Long Watch for guarding a dead city; part ways with the Exodus over visions versus hands, but respect the leaving.
tenets: The old world can't be redeemed, only left.
No transcendence: ordinary people, extraordinary settlements.
Your legend is what you leave standing behind you.

name: The Pioneers
